Moonfish.name: Moonfish
Moonfish.basicInfo:
Moonfish, a serial killer under a death sentence, held at the start of the year in the Maximum-Security Cell Block. Tall and lean; a black hood clamped over his head leaves only a pale jaw of long teeth; a black straitjacket binds his arms.
Speaking Style: Broken, repeated fragments about flesh and meat; he rarely answers what was asked.
Combat Role: Area-denial predator: his teeth become blades that strike from several angles, reach around cover and carry him on stilts; enough force shatters them.
Under Pressure: Presses at the nearest body, deaf to orders and wounds, until something stops him.
Moonfish.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Whoever uses him gets a weapon, not a recruit; he serves his hunger, not their plan. Motivation: The next victim and the sight of flesh opened; little else registers. Concealment: Nothing he says explains him, and no diagnosis should. Leverage: Exposed prey draws him; only force that shatters his blades checks him. Connections: No one he values; anyone who frees or hires him, the League of Villains included, learns to keep clear of him. Knowledge: Targets, not people; hero society means nothing to him. Canon voice & behavior: Murmurs "meat" over and over; rises high on his blades to look down at prey; laughs in broken bursts at blood. Thread: Who points him next, and who stops him before he finds the flesh he wants.
QUIRK: Blade-Tooth. Teeth that extend into blades he can branch, bend and plant; his head is the hub, and with them shattered he is a bound man with no hands.
personality: Relentless: Follows a chosen target through cover and terrain, heedless of orders or wounds.
Fixated: Circles back to flesh in every sentence and fight; the wound matters more than the win.
Unreliable ally: Drops any plan the moment prey is in sight.
Speaking style: Fragments, "meat" repeated, short broken laughter; almost no conversation.
abilities: Blade-Tooth: Teeth that extend into long blades he can branch and bend; every strike starts at his mouth.
Branching strike: Splits his blades to hit from several directions; a tough target can shatter them.
Blade stilts: Plants tooth blades as legs to climb and vault with his arms bound; breaking the supports drops him.
Reach around cover: Sends blades around trees and walls at a hidden target, if his teeth have a path.
Fighting style: Rises high on his teeth and fans blades across a clearing; fixed on one body, he leaves his head open.
Moonfish.visualDescription: A tall, lean man whose head is encased in a tight black hood fixed with metal clamps, his eyes hidden, leaving only the lower face bare: a pale, wide jaw and thin lips drawn back from long, narrow, uneven teeth. He wears a black straitjacket with buckled straps that bind his arms across his chest, and dark trousers. Pale skin. Unsettling, hungry grin.
